content: {"praised":["Deep Red was unique and different from other sci‑fi films.","Evolution’s Child tackled science, ethics, and independence themes well.","Night Visitors was a rare 90s made‑for‑TV sci‑fi gem.","The set offered a variety of sci‑fi titles for fans.","The star in Deep Red was a highlight for viewers."],"criticized":["The collection omitted It Came From Outer Space II as advertised.","Only two movies were included, disappointing expectations.","Some titles on the set were described as hokey.","The set did not match the advertised six‑movie lineup.","Viewers felt the content was not what they wanted."]}
